Managed MenuLayer with full callback management

Provides a safe, ARC-managed wrapper around MenuLayer which stores user callbacks as Nim procs/closures and dispatches them via C-cdecl trampolines using the callback context pointer. This keeps callbacks alive while the MenuLayer is in use and avoids GC issues.

Register callbacks. The wrapper is copied to heap and kept alive until the handle is destroyed or setCallbacks is called again.

Required Callbacks: The following callbacks must be provided for the menu to function correctly. Passing nil for these will raise an assertion in debug/strict mode:

  • getNumSections: Return number of sections in the menu
  • getNumRows: Return number of rows in a given section
  • drawRow: Draw the contents of a row cell

Optional Callbacks: These can be nil if not needed:

  • selectClick, selectLongClick: Handle selection events
  • getHeaderHeight, drawHeader: Section headers
  • getCellHeight: Custom row heights (default used if nil)
  • selectionChanged, selectionWillChange: Selection change notifications
  • getSeparatorHeight, drawSeparator: Row separators
  • drawBackground: Custom background drawing
